definition: A 9B Qwen3.5 model, used across 4 sources as the small-to-mid open backbone where domain fine-tuning is shown to close a gap to frontier systems. Its clearest archived result: answer-only supervision lifts it from 37.4 to 75.1 percent micro accuracy on an industrial-safety benchmark and chain-of-thought supervision reaches 89.0, the highest micro accuracy of any configuration tested and slightly above a frontier model -- though a frontier model keeps the best macro, so the fine-tuned model is less uniform across categories. It also appears as a poisoning subject, in latent-communication sparse coding, and in financial reasoning evaluation.

evidence.note: Shows that supervised fine-tuning can install a triggered backdoor whose visible reasoning stays clean, correct and topically benign while the final answer is attacker-chosen — leaving CoT-only monitors at chance (AUC 0.44-0.55) and recovering detection only when the monitor is shown the answer alongside the trace (0.76-1.00).
evidence.title: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Through Model Poisoning

evidence.note: Builds an industrial-safety reasoning benchmark from two pipelines -- program execution over safety scene graphs, and evidence graphs extracted from real accident-investigation reports -- and shows that general multimodal capability does not transfer to it while a 9B model fine-tuned on its chain-of-thought split matches frontier systems.
evidence.title: SafeSceneReason: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark Connecting Industrial Hazards with Accident Knowledge

evidence.note: Fits a post-hoc sparse autoencoder to the frozen dense tensors that two vision-language agents exchange, finds a 128-fold payload reduction at near-identical reconstruction and roughly unchanged single-run accuracy, and then spends most of the paper enumerating the alternative explanations its own design cannot rule out.
evidence.title: Post-Hoc Sparse Coding of Latent Communication Between Vision-Language Model Agents

evidence.note: Generates financial reasoning benchmarks from executable computation trees over real tables so that answers are correct by construction with no model in the labelling loop, exposes four independently controllable difficulty axes, and finds that unit and scale perturbations collapse the strongest model from 98.4 percent to 3.0.
evidence.title: V-FiLLM: Verified Financial LLM Reasoning Benchmark

name: Qwen3.5-9B
